# FoxURL

> FoxURL builds digital infrastructure and cloud-based applications. It does not make URL shorteners or simple links; it creates connected tools and services for the web.

## Public sites

- [FoxURL regional router](https://foxurl.github.io/): Selects a regional site using the visitor's browser locale.
- [FoxURL International](https://foxurl.github.io/en/): International English site.
- [FoxURL Australia](https://foxurl.github.io/au/): Australian site.
- [FoxURL Europe](https://foxurl.github.io/eu/): European site.
- [FoxURL United Kingdom](https://foxurl.github.io/uk/): UK site.
- [FoxURL App](https://foxurl.github.io/app/): Standalone home-screen app experience.
